hints.text: This is your data center. Click it.
Press WASD or the arrow keys once per step, or drag a path. Steer to the DC marked 10. The numbers on the path show what will arrive.
Moves happen 2 per turn. Q clears the whole queue.
Captured. Auto mode kept 4 at home: that's the **safe level** in the top bar. Never drain a DC below it.
The DC marked 12 is 5 steps away, so you need about 21 at S. Your DCs make 2 power a turn. Wait for it, then go.
In real games, fog hides the map. You only see cells next to your land, and grey blocks in the fog may be mountains or DCs. Expand to find out.
